```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS as_of
),
target_model AS (
  SELECT model_id
  FROM company_model
  WHERE model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
),
explosion(component_id, qty, is_assembly) AS (
  SELECT
    mb.component_id,
    CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty,
    c.is_assembly
  FROM model_bom mb
  JOIN target_model tm ON mb.model_id = tm.model_id
  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE mb.valid_from <= p.as_of
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR p.as_of <= mb.valid_to)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    cb.child_component_id,
    e.qty * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty,
    c.is_assembly
  FROM explosion e
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cb.child_component_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.is_assembly = TRUE
    AND cb.valid_from <= p.as_of
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR p.as_of <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explosion e
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

WITH target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'SW8-140BLK02-0002'
),
sku_model_unit AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs that directly map to the target model
    SELECT
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty::DOUBLE AS qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku s
        ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs whose item SKUs map to the target model
    SELECT
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        (bi.qty * sm.qty)::DOUBLE AS qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku item
        ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
       AND item.is_bundle = FALSE
    JOIN sku_model sm
        ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
sold AS (
    SELECT
        l.sku_id,
        ol.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o
        ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l
        ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(sol.qty * smu.qty_per_sku), 0) AS units_sold
FROM sold sol
JOIN sku_model_unit smu
    ON smu.sku_id = sol.sku_id
JOIN target_model tm
    ON tm.model_id = smu.model_id;

WITH RECURSIVE expansion(sku_id, model_id, qty) AS (
  -- Direct model mappings for non-bundle SKUs

  FROM sku_model sm
  JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
  WHERE s.is_bundle = false
  UNION ALL
  -- Bundle expansion: qty of bundle item * qty of model per item SKU
